title: Add text to application launchers when an Icons-and-Text Task Manager is used on a vertical panel, where there's always room for text
line: Pinned apps in the Icons-and-Text Task Manager now show their names on vertical panels.
explanation: Task.qml hid the text label of every launcher task, even in the Icons-and-Text Task Manager. On a horizontal panel that is intended, since launchers are sized as square icons there, but on a vertical panel every row already spans the panel's full width, so pinned apps showed as lone centered icons beside full window rows. The label is now also shown for launchers when the panel is vertical; the existing width check still hides it on thin vertical panels, and horizontal panels are unchanged.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: show launcher names on vertical panels

Pinned launchers in the Icons-and-Text Task Manager always hid their
label, so on a vertical panel they were lone centered icons next to full
window rows. Show the app name there when the panel is wide enough.

BUG: 495728

patches.diff:
From e65633928e4a4fbd7067ba747d973887082e7eec Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 19:11:53 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/taskmanager: show launcher names on vertical panels

Pinned launchers in the Icons-and-Text Task Manager always hid their
label, so on a vertical panel they were lone centered icons next to full
window rows. Show the app name there when the panel is wide enough.

BUG: 495728
---
 applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml | 4 ++--
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml
index 90530078c5..a98fb68506 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml
@@ -54,7 +54,7 @@ PlasmaCore.ToolTipArea {
     readonly property int pid: model.AppPid
     readonly property string appName: model.AppName
     readonly property string appId: model.AppId
-    readonly property bool isIcon: tasksRoot.iconsOnly || model.IsLauncher
+    readonly property bool isIcon: tasksRoot.iconsOnly || (model.IsLauncher && !tasksRoot.vertical)
     property bool toolTipOpen: false
     property bool inPopup: false
     property bool isWindow: model.IsWindow
@@ -614,7 +614,7 @@ PlasmaCore.ToolTipArea {
     PlasmaComponents3.Label {
         id: label
 
-        visible: (task.inPopup || !task.tasksRoot.iconsOnly && !task.model.IsLauncher
+        visible: (task.inPopup || !task.tasksRoot.iconsOnly && (!task.model.IsLauncher || task.tasksRoot.vertical)
             && (parent.width - iconBox.height - Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing) >= TaskManagerApplet.LayoutMetrics.spaceRequiredToShowText())
 
         anchors {
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Vertical panel, Icons-and-Text Task Manager: pinned Dolphin, System Settings and Discover are bare centered icons
Same panel with the fix: the pinned apps show their names, aligned like the window row below
Horizontal Icons-and-Text Task Manager (right): the pinned Dolphin launcher stays an icon, as before
Thin vertical panel (48 px): there is no room for text, so launchers and windows stay icon-only

review.text: Cleanly enables launcher text labels in the Icons-and-Text Task Manager on vertical panels while keeping `isIcon` consistent and preserving the existing width threshold for thin vertical panels and square-icon launchers on horizontal panels. The existing `standalone` icon state and launcher frame styling handle alignment and visual differentiation from open windows naturally. Screenshots cover wide vertical, thin vertical, and horizontal panels convincingly.
